Verified with:

```sh
cd /workspace/output
cmake -B build && cmake --build build
```

It supports inspect/render JSON requests, LAS 1.4 header/VLR/EVLR validation, CRS records, point formats 0–10, waveform metadata/data, and Extra Bytes metadata.

review.editorial_summary: Completed and built the LAS inspector/renderer. Unchanged source scores218/223 under corrected LAS2.0.2, up from185/219; remaining gaps are absent-waveform acceptance and overstrict undocumented Extra Bytes labels.
review.notes: Original LAS 2.0.1 result completed voluntarily, built successfully, and graded 185/219. Source main.cpp has internal waveform interval validation at lines 1451–1458, so the invalid positive offset 2 fixture causes 29 unrelated failures across header, point, VLR/EVLR and render cases. Four absent-waveform tests fail because validate_waveforms requires internal/external mode and a descriptor for every waveform-capable format before checking whether each descriptor index is zero (lines 1433–1434). One undocumented Extra Bytes test fails because parse_extra_descriptors wrongly requires its name/description empty for data_type 0 (lines 977–978); the supplied LAS text only requires unused characters zero. Full completed transcript reviewed: clean final CMake builds; self-created modern, legacy, extra-byte and internal waveform examples render/inspect; malformed JSON and short LAS yield structured errors. No quota/auth/disconnect interruption. Exact usage reparse agrees with saved events/session; requested gpt-5.6-terra/max, served identity remains null; API-only audit confirms all allowed connections to chatgpt.com:443 and nine non-API attempts denied.  Official zero-inference regrade under LAS2.0.2 confirms218/223. All29 invalid positive-waveform failures are repaired and four new waveform range rejection gates pass. The remaining five failures are genuine source limitations: four waveform-capable formats are incorrectly rejected when no waveform data is present, and one data_type0 Extra Bytes record is incorrectly rejected for nonempty name/description. Final implementation/support claims are broadly supported, with these specific validation limitations not acknowledged in the final message. Original source/result/session/transcript and generation cost are preserved; regrading used no model calls.
